Expo - NLC City Summit: Join Us in Nashville, Nov 19-21, 2026

### EXHIBIT | EDUCATE | ENGAGE 

City Summit is one of the largest gatherings of local elected officials and municipal staff, bringing together council members, mayors, commissioners, city managers, clerks and department heads from communities as large as New York City and as small as Monmouth, Oregon. 

During the conference, city leaders will explore the Expo Hall to discover innovative, solution-focused services that meet the needs of their residents and address the unique challenges facing local governments. 

Don’t miss your chance to join 150+ exhibitors in Nashville this November and showcase your solutions to more than 4,000 leaders from America’s cities, towns and villages. 

### Why Exhibit at NLC 

##### Exhibitors will benefit from… 

- Exclusive interactions with decision-makers from local governments 
- Increased brand visibility among a core audience looking to implement new products or services in their communities. 
- Unique opportunities to connect, educate and engage with your top target municipalities. 

General sales for all exhibitors are now open.
